LanguageData.LP_SoulCoin.label: soul coin
LanguageData.LP_SoulCoin.description: The currency of the Abyss: a cold black iron coin with a screaming soul locked in its face. Abyssal rituals use it in place of live sacrifices; a lich can absorb it into the phylactery (each worth 25% of sacrificing an ordinary corpse). Carrying 10 or more in a pack is unsettling. Cannot be crafted; only obtained by soul refining or from demons.
LanguageData.LP_DemonBlood.label: demon blood
LanguageData.LP_DemonBlood.description: A small steaming vial of black-red blood. Drinking it: +15% melee damage and -10% pain for 1 day, but +8% abyssal taint. One of the tier 2 offerings for abyssal rituals; alchemy table recipes will use it later.
LanguageData.LP_Demonomicon.label: demonology tome
LanguageData.LP_Demonomicon.description: A forbidden book recording the true names, habits and summoning rituals of abyssal demons. Each copy details only one kind of demon (barlgura, hezrou, succubus, nabassu, marilith or balor). After 4 hours of reading the colony learns to summon it at the abyssal circle; reading adds +0.5% abyssal taint per hour. Keeping it on the map slowly thins the plane.
LanguageData.LP_TrueNameScroll.label: true name scroll
LanguageData.LP_TrueNameScroll.description: A parchment bearing an outsider's true name. Holding the true name scroll of your own bound one halves its obedience decay. Speak the true name to an enemy recorded on the scroll and it must make a Charisma save or be banished to its home plane at once. Rituals summoning the same kind of outsider get +10% success chance. It can also seal an abyssal rift outright (uses up the scroll).
LanguageData.LP_DimensionalShackles.label: planar anchor chain
LanguageData.LP_DimensionalShackles.description: Silver and cold iron shackles covered in anchoring runes. Put them on a downed outsider and it will no longer be banished and can be captured. When a colonist carries an anchor chain in their pack, hostile outsiders that fall within 5 cells are chained automatically. Outsider prisoners in anchor chains held in a room with a binding circle will not escape and can be interrogated for their true name.
LanguageData.LP_GorgedFang.label: soul-gorged fang
LanguageData.LP_GorgedFang.description: A long nabassu fang strung on a leather cord around the neck. The wearer gains a "soul-gorged fang" stack for each humanlike killed (+1% damage, up to 10 stacks, cleared on death), but abyssal taint +0.2% per day while worn. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
